dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: I'm a diver employed by the Spina di Rosula, so I usually don't accept outside commissions. I hope you'll understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about diving...

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: If people without Visions want to dive, they need to go through specialized training first, and they must be accompanied by a professional diver when they first go underwater.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: The underwater world is very beautiful, but never underestimate its potential dangers.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: For example, most people only pay attention to whether their diving equipment is intact and functional, but ignore their own physical condition.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: If you do not warm up before a dive, or if you cannot adapt to the water pressure in time, you can get muscle cramps or symptoms such as tinnitus.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it...

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Sure. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: I'm the diver hired by Spina di Rosula, and I'm afraid I'm not taking any other commissions. My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: For rebuilding Poisson, right?

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Hmm... half-and-half.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: It's partly to clear out the junk in the water and perform underwater reconstruction work. And partly to recover everyone's belongings.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Loads of valuables belonging to the citizens were washed away. It doesn't matter how much they're actually worth, but they all meant something.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: I'd like to help recover them, if I can.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Okay, goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the flood...

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: The situation was bad back then, but it's all in the past now.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: This is exactly why I've constantly emphasized the necessity of regular diving equipment checks. It's so that we're always ready to deal with emergencies like this.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Even though Navia said that the kind of disaster mentioned in the prophecy won't happen again, we should still pay attention to our safety.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Okay, goodbye.
